description: This file defines the internal class SQSAdapterReceiver which implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface. It handles receiving, processing, and deleting messages from an Amazon SQS queue, including initialization and shutdown procedures, message retrieval, and delivery confirmation.

classes.name: SQSAdapterReceiver
classes.description: An internal class that receives message batches from an Amazon SQS queue, manages message fetching, processing, and deletion, and handles initialization and shutdown logic.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SQSAdapterReceiver instance with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the receiver, ensuring all outstanding tasks are completed and resources are released.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Fetches up to maxCount messages from the queue asynchronously and returns them as a list of IBatchContainer.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Confirms message delivery by deleting messages from the queue after processing.
